rationale: a commit cannot contain its own SHA; the envelope binds the result head via tested_parent_sha + result_tree_sha and the container commit is resolved externally after push

required_fields.build_provenance: path to leaf provenance receipt (must match build-provenance-policy-v3.json)

external_branch_binding.note: controller records the branch remote sha AFTER push; remote sha must equal result head

required_fields.result_head_placeholder: BOUND_IN_EXTERNAL_BRANCH (never the envelope's own container SHA)
required_fields.result_tree_sha: SHA-256 of the result commit tree (resolved externally as HEAD^{tree})
required_fields.tested_parent_sha: SHA-256 of the parent commit (must equal the candidate base)

validation_rules: envelope is committed BY THE LEAF at the frozen owned path in the SAME result commit
controller verifies remote branch sha == result_head after push
artifact hashes verified against the result tree blobs
no field may contain the envelope's own container SHA
